mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a comfortable temperature of 68 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to recognize the hard work of our planning department. Also, don't forget that if you receive a letter from the Water Utility, you should schedule your cross-connection inspection soon to keep our water clean.

We have a busy day! Today, you can check out the World Dairy Expo, live music at Bailey's Run, and the apple cider pressing festival at the Farley Center. Tomorrow, yoga is available at Insight Wellness to keep you moving.
On September 21, officers were called to investigate a retail theft involving Swedish Fish at a retailer on East Verona Avenue, where the individual was later identified.
The delicious Andes Mint Avalanche is the flavor of the day. Since the restaurant is currently open until 10:00 PM, make sure to stop by and grab a treat before they close for the night.
